subject: Request: ModelSprint hackathon credits for NeuroText (maintainer sponsorship)
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@modelsprint.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsor credits for NeuroText

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking a look — I'm Alex, one of the organizers for ModelSprint (an annual 48-hour hackathon focused on open-source model tooling). Our community maintainers for NeuroText (https://github.com/opencode/neurotext) are hoping to have access to hosted inference so participants can prototype on real workloads.

Would Redwood consider providing free credits (trial or community grant) to NeuroText maintainers to be used as a sponsoring perk for their team and for hackathon project teams building on top of NeuroText?

What we'd ideally need: a pool of credits valid for 6 months that maintainers and selected hackathon teams can use, plus a short blurb we can include on the event page. Estimated usage: ~300k token-equivalent for initial month, another 200k tokens spread over participants.

Attached: modelsprint_sponsor_form.pdf and a short README about NeuroText (neurotext-readme.md). Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Alex Rivera
ModelSprint Organizer
alex@modelsprint.org

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@modelsprint.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsor credits for NeuroText

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Really appreciate the community focus here.

I can put together a community credit grant; before I confirm I need to align with our partnerships and sales leads on the budget bucket and any restrictions. Could you confirm whether NeuroText will be the sole maintainer beneficiary (one admin list) or if credits need to be distributed to 20+ hackathon teams individually? That affects how we provision.

Tentatively thinking: 300k token credits for the NeuroText maintainer pool + 100k tokens reserved for hackathon winner teams, valid 6 months. If that works, I'll escalate to our partnerships lead (Vivek) and billing to provision.

Also: please share the event blurb you'd like us to publish as a sponsor line.

- Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsorship credits for NeuroText

Team — forwarding a request from ModelSprint / OpenCode for community credits for their NeuroText maintainers (attached sponsor form). Summary:
- Ask: community credit pool for maintainers + runway for hackathon teams
- Suggested allocation: 300k tokens to maintainer pool + 100k tokens for hackathon winners (total 400k tokens)
- Validity requested: 6 months
- External org: ModelSprint / OpenCode Collective

Can we approve 400k credits from the community sponsorship budget? If approved, billing/provisioning will need to create a temporary promo code or project-level credits (decide based on grace's guidance).

Proposed public blurb (draft): "Redwood Inference is proud to sponsor ModelSprint 2026 — providing hosted inference credits to NeuroText maintainers and top hackathon teams. Learn more: https://redwood.com/sponsorships"

Attaching the form again for context.

-- Camila

[Attachment: modelsprint_sponsor_form.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsorship credits for NeuroText

Thanks Camila — I like this one (community reach and good open-source signal). Approve 350k tokens from the community sponsorship bucket with one condition: we reserve an extra 50k tokens pending a short report from the maintainers showing how credits were allocated (simple spreadsheet) and a short blurb for marketing. If the maintainers provide the report within 8 weeks, we release the extra 50k.

Monica, can you confirm billing flow: would you prefer a promo code or creating a dedicated project with a prepaid credit balance? Also confirm whether we need an MSA/MPA for this level of credit.

- Vivek
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsorship credits for NeuroText

Sounds good. A couple quick operational clarifications:
- Billing: promo code is easiest for maintainers but harder to track usage across teams; dedicated project (prepaid credits) gives us better observability. For a community grant I'd prefer dedicated project.
- Contract: no MSA needed for a credit grant of this size; we should have them accept our sponsorship terms (short T&Cs) and a recipient contact for the allocation report.
- Activation: provisioning team will need the external contact (Alex) and a primary recipient email for NeuroText maintainers (Samir or similar).

Monica — can you create the project and apply 350k tokens now, with a flag to hold 50k until we receive the allocation report? If you need to surface to finance for bookkeeping let me know.

- Grace
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@modelsprint.org>, Samir Khan <samir@opencode.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: ModelSprint hackathon — sponsorship credits for NeuroText (APPROVED)

Hi Alex / Samir — great news: Redwood has approved a 350k token community grant for NeuroText, with an additional 50k tokens to be released after a short allocation report (spreadsheet) and a brief marketing blurb.

Next steps:
- Monica (cc) will create a dedicated project and load 350k tokens.
- Provisioning ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 (use this to track activation).
- Please reply with the primary maintainer email that should receive the project invite (one email for now; you can add team members later).
- Blurb for event page (if you want to tweak): "Redwood Inference provides hosted inference credits to open-source maintainers at ModelSprint 2026. See our community programs at https://redwood.com/sponsorships"

Camila Reyes
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

[Attachment: neurotext-readme.md]
